referenceRequirements.environment: clean dry speech with low background noise and no music
referenceRequirements.corpusBinding: must match at least one of the fixed eight Compass beats for first fit
referenceRequirements.provenance: source, recorder/speaker authorization, date, and hash required

alignmentLaw: Reference and G4 prediction must be time-aligned in a stable acoustic domain before residual extraction; unaligned waveform subtraction is prohibited.
